# Highlights

*779 PRs from 227 contributors.*

## New models

| Model | Type | Cookbook |
|---|---|---|
| DeepSeek-V4.1 Flash | LLM / VLM | [link](https://docs.sglang.io/cookbook/autoregressive/DeepSeek/DeepSeek-V4_1) |
| GigaChat 3.5 | LLM / VLM | [link](https://docs.sglang.io/cookbook/autoregressive/GigaChat/GigaChat3.5) |
| IQuest-Q1 | LLM / VLM | [link](https://docs.sglang.io/cookbook/autoregressive/IQuestLab/IQuest-Q1) |
| MiMo-V2.6 / MiMo-V2.6-Pro | LLM / VLM | [link](https://docs.sglang.io/cookbook/autoregressive/Xiaomi/MiMo-V2.6) |
| Ling-3.0-flash-VL | LLM / VLM | [link](https://docs.sglang.io/cookbook/autoregressive/InclusionAI/Ling-3.0-flash-VL) |
| DiffusionGemma | Diffusion | [link](https://docs.sglang.io/cookbook/autoregressive/Google/DiffusionGemma) |
| Qwen-Image 2.1 | Diffusion | [link](https://docs.sglang.io/cookbook/diffusion/Qwen-Image/Qwen-Image-2.1) |
| Anima Base v1.0 | Diffusion | [link](https://docs.sglang.io/cookbook/diffusion/CircleStone/Anima) |
| Ming-Image 0.1 Design / Design-Layer | Diffusion | [link](https://docs.sglang.io/cookbook/diffusion/inclusionAI/Ming-Image) |
| FLUX 3 Action | Diffusion | [link](https://docs.sglang.io/cookbook/vla/FLUX/FLUX-3-Action) |

## Key features

* PD instances can switch between prefill and decode on the fly, no restart needed ([#28403](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/28403)).
* The prefix cache now runs on a Rust core by default ([#39627](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/39627)).
* DeepSeek-V4.1 gets 22% faster first token on long prompts ([#40352](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40352)).
* Kimi K3 gets 20.6% higher prefill throughput in PD serving ([#40045](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40045)).
* GLM-5.3-Flash now runs on AMD MI355X, with FP8 / MXFP4 MoE and MTP speculative decoding ([#38546](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/38546), [#39341](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/39341), [#39778](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/39778)).
* More accurate results under PP, DP attention, and CP, with layer communication now handled by SGLang ([guide](https://docs.sglang.io/docs/developer_guide/layer_boundary), [#41557](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41557)).
* New Decisions API (`/v1/decisions`) turns an LLM / VLM into a low-latency classifier and scorer ([docs](https://docs.sglang.io/docs/supported-models/decision_models), [#41208](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41208)).
* Score API (`/v1/score`) scores all candidates in one request ([#38965](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/38965), [#41188](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41188)).
* Run MiniMax-H3 with SGLang Diffusion inside ComfyUI ([#35990](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/35990)).

## To upgrade

```bash
uv pip install --prerelease=allow sglang==0.5.21
```

| Platform | Docker |
|---|---|
| NVIDIA (CUDA 13) | [`docker pull lmsysorg/sglang:v0.5.21`](https://hub.docker.com/r/lmsysorg/sglang/tags?name=v0.5.21) |
| AMD MI35x | [`docker pull lmsysorg/sglang:v0.5.21-rocm10-mi35x`](https://hub.docker.com/r/lmsysorg/sglang/tags?name=v0.5.21-rocm10-mi35x) |
| AMD MI30x | [`docker pull lmsysorg/sglang:v0.5.21-rocm10-mi30x`](https://hub.docker.com/r/lmsysorg/sglang/tags?name=v0.5.21-rocm10-mi30x) |
| Intel GPU | [`docker pull lmsysorg/sglang:v0.5.21-xpu`](https://hub.docker.com/r/lmsysorg/sglang/tags?name=v0.5.21-xpu) |
| Intel CPU | [`docker pull lmsysorg/sglang:v0.5.21-xeon`](https://hub.docker.com/r/lmsysorg/sglang/tags?name=v0.5.21-xeon) |

# Full Release Notes

## Speculative Decoding

* Pipeline parallelism x speculative decoding (EAGLE/MTP) compatibility: [#30775](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/30775)
* Support XQA backend for SpecDec verify: [#32269](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/32269)
* [Spec] Windowed draft-decode attention for built-in EAGLE / MTP drafts: [#32673](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/32673)
* Avoid materializing GDN QKV tensors during target verification: [#33778](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/33778)
* [Spec] Fix CDF boundary handling in `TreeSpeculativeSamplingTargetOnly`: [#35798](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/35798)
* [Spec] Add LiLiCorr: a candidate-lattice reranker for DFlash drafts: [#37462](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/37462)
* Add out-of-tree DFlash extension points: [#38740](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/38740)
* [Spec] Add explicit prefill shared-read capability for plugins: [#39502](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/39502)
* [Fix] Don't write conv state from the fused KDA verify kernel: [#39524](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/39524)
* [Spec] Model-agnostic last-stage draft embedding under pipeline parallelism: [#39643](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/39643)
* Use runtime token widths for Triton speculative verification: [#39859](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/39859)
* avoid host sync in DSpark prefill slot expansion: [#40111](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40111)
* [Experimental] Preserve speculative decoding during prefill across DP ranks: [#40118](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40118)
* [Spec][PP] Launch extend microbatches before the spec output exchange: [#40499](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40499)
* [KDA] Enable ReplaySSM for GLM-5.3 Flash: [#40517](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40517)
* [LFM2-VL] Add DSpark speculative decoding (1.66x to 2.56x speedup at batch 1): [#40651](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40651)
* [Spec] Support DFLASH for Kimi K3: [#40794](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40794)
* [Fix] Reduce Nemotron MTP attention outputs once: [#40800](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40800)
* [Fix] Capture complete Nemotron auxiliary hidden states: [#40801](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40801)
* [Fix] Skip the DCP target-verify MLA kernel during FlashInfer autotune: [#41138](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41138)
* Fix mixed chunk prefill with DP speculative coordination: [#41179](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41179)
* [Fix] Plan NextN / MTP draft layers as one-layer models and fix the Bailing V2 NextN draft: [#41194](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41194)

## Piecewise & Breakable CUDA Graph

* [Fix] Preserve model runner contracts in prefill CUDA graphs: [#35452](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/35452)
* [DSV4][BCG] Optimize the heavy memory use of C4 Indexer when BCG is enabled (capture memory down 58% to 18 GB): [#36534](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/36534)
* [Fix] Don't free the multi-CTAs KV counter the decode graphs captured: [#39175](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/39175)
* [CPU] Avoid prefill CP predicates during decode graph capture: [#39690](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/39690)
* [Runtime] Add decode CUDA graph hooks for eager logits processing: [#40222](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40222)
* [Kimi K3] Fix CUDA graph stream explosion: [#40640](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40640)
* [DSpark] Fix draft CUDA graph stream explosion: [#40658](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40658)
* [Fix] Give the full prefill CUDA graph replay view the captured bucket's input_ids: [#40851](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40851)
* [DSA] Fix the pooled-indexer breakable prefill bridge under DP attention: [#41311](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41311)

## Attention Backends

* Allow attention layers to opt out of the prefill wrapper: [#40683](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40683)
* [Fix] Use cached prefix lengths for FlashInfer full-attention ragged prefill: [#40796](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40796)

## MoE & Expert Parallelism

* [3/N] elastic-ep: Recapture decode CUDA graphs after scale-up: [#33723](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/33723)
* Fix int4 MoE tuner config filename: [#35260](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/35260)
* [MegaMoE] Wire Qwen MoE blocks to DeepGEMM MegaMoE (MXFP4 and NVFP4 experts): [#38080](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/38080)
* [Feature] Support BF16 and batch-invariant inference with DeepEP v2: [#38160](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/38160)
* [Perf] Optimize w4a8 MoE for glm5.2 on H200: [#38220](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/38220)
* [Fix] Guard FlashInfer CUTLASS MoE against 0-token inputs: [#38780](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/38780)
* [Kernel] Add H20 block-FP8 MoE configs for GLM-5.3-Flash EP4/EP8: [#38913](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/38913)
* Accept MXFP8 dispatch in FlashInfer A2A TRT-LLM MoE: [#39613](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/39613)
* [MoE] Honor swiglu_limit clamped activation in flashinfer_cutlass runner: [#39939](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/39939)
* Support MXFP8 and deferred route weighting in DeepEP v2: [#40030](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40030)
* [MoE] Disable FlashInfer fused finalize by default for numerical accuracy: [#40105](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40105)
* [Fix] Fix top-1 MoE routing with non-unit scaling: [#40187](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40187)
* [DeepEP v2] support GLM-5.3-Flash (Glm5NextForConditionalGeneration): [#40466](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40466)
* [Fix] Decide the MoE padded-row bound from the layer scatter mode: [#40672](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40672)
* [DeepEP v2] Let a model package supply its per-rank prefill dispatch bound: [#41201](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41201)

## Quantization

* [MXFP8-KV] Skip writes to the reserved CUDA-graph padding slot: [#35351](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/35351)
* feat(kv-cache): support SM100 NVFP4 GenMHA and speculative decoding (1.355x faster decode attention kernel at 1M context): [#36340](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/36340)
* [Quant] ModelOpt mixed precision: dispatch block-FP8 MoE experts and derive the block size: [#38726](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/38726)
* fix(modelopt): dispatch NVFP4 MoE on the cached backend, not the live global: [#38932](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/38932)
* [Quant] Serve 32-wide-K ue8m0 block-FP8 linears through the FlashInfer MXFP8 GEMMs: [#40039](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40039)
* [ModelOpt][PP] Keep BF16 shared experts out of the NVFP4 fusion so TP1 pipeline stages can load: [#40628](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40628)

## Parallelism & Disaggregation

* [PD] Introduce runtime role switching between prefill and decode: [#28403](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/28403)
* disaggregation: Fix FakeKVSender queue accumulation: [#28652](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/28652)
* [PD] Keep EAGLE DP graph and token metadata consistent: [#32196](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/32196)
* [NVIDIA][comm] Merge EP+MoE-TP post-experts all-reduces into one _TP reduction: [#32963](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/32963)
* Add 8-node AllReduce/AllGather and MNVLS algorithm support to MSCCL++: [#37442](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/37442)
* [KV-Shard 2/4] Sharded pools: [#37615](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/37615)
* [KV-Shard 3/4] Enable Control plane: [#38468](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/38468)
* [KV-Shard 3/4] Enable Control Plane B: [#39964](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/39964)
* Fix device context during NIXL backend initialization: [#38774](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/38774)
* [PD] Do not admit intake-rejected requests to a PD handoff: [#38935](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/38935)
* Reduce decode bootstrap latency with request-owned speculative KV (mean TTFT 19.4 to 15.1 s on DeepSeek-V4-Pro 1P1D, MI355X, concurrency 256): [#38978](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/38978)
* Fix disagg PP MTP for GLM-5.2: [#39378](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/39378)
* [PD] Add optional KV transfer checksums: [#39500](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/39500)
* [DCP] Use logical token capacity for PD admission and load reporting: [#39731](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/39731)
* Refactor the Cute-DSL AR fusion to support DeepseekV2 archs (GLM-5.3, etc.): [#39816](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/39816)
* [PD] Validate Mooncake EFA allocator compatibility: [#39973](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/39973)
* [PD] Skip singleton transfer-status all-reduces: [#40003](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40003)
* [PD] Enable optimistic prefill with buffer-only L3 write-through HiCache: [#40043](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40043)
* [Kimi K3][PD] support pp prefill + dcp decode with dspark: [#40045](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40045)
* [PD] Add decode host receive for custom transfer backends: [#40238](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40238)
* [PD] Allow decode radix cache and HiCache L1/L2 with DCP: [#40263](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40263)
* [PD] Enter the custom mem pool once when allocating DCP pack buffers: [#40284](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40284)
* [PD] Bound cached-prefix DCP transfers by pack capacity (cached-prefix throughput about 10.9x higher at concurrency 8 on Kimi Linear, 8x B200): [#40376](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40376)
* [PD] Pack draft KV head slices for DCP transfers: [#40500](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40500)
* [PD] Preserve abort ACKs until in-flight KV transfers drain: [#40645](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40645)
* Fix NIXL transfer of MXFP8 KV block scales: [#40792](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40792)
* [PD] Honor gracefully_exit in disaggregation event loops and keep non-zero-rank launchers alive on SIGTERM: [#40793](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40793)
* [DP Attention] Publish DP buffer sizes from a ForwardBatch: [#40858](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40858)
* [PD] Enable deferred decode-side KV release by default: [#41023](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41023)
* [PD] Add a `none` decode retraction backup and subclass seams in the PD queues: [#41103](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41103)
* [PD] fix: cache resumed decode-radix requests from root instead of an unlocked re-match: [#41261](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41261)
* [PD] Fan drain abort ACKs out to every decode peer of the room: [#41402](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41402)
* [PD] Defer decode KV release on every transfer failure, not only decode-initiated aborts: [#41404](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41404)
* [Fix] Stop deferring the last layer's FFN all-reduce in five models: [#40868](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40868)
* [Fix] Complete the deferred FFN all-reduce before a pipeline-parallel send: [#41079](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41079)
* [Fix] Complete the deferred FFN all-reduce before deepstack addition and aux hidden-state capture: [#41080](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41080)
* [Fix] Step-3.5: stop dense layers from summing their output twice under DP attention: [#41082](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41082)
* [Fix] Broadcast requests along attention CP before attention TP: [#41083](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41083)
* [Fix] Complete the all-reduce when the flashinfer fused norm declines a batch: [#41193](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41193)
* [Fix] Stop counting a deferred FFN sum more than once: replicated TP1 shared expert, dense reduce_scatterv: [#41195](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41195)
*

items.title: WorkflowArena: Benchmarking Executable Workflow Orchestration in LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems
items.summary: Large language model agents are increasingly deployed as multi-agent systems rather than as a standalone model operating within a single context. Recent agent harnesses allow……
items.abstract: Large language model agents are increasingly deployed as multi-agent systems rather than as a standalone model operating within a single context. Recent agent harnesses allow the model to instantiate worker agents and to author the executable workflow that coordinates them, shifting the design of system structure from developers to the model at run time. The quality of this organization therefore constitutes a distinct capability, yet existing benchmarks either measure end-to-end task completion or evaluate coordination under structures specified in advance. We formalize this capability as workflow orchestration and introduce WorkflowArena, a benchmark of 145 long-horizon tasks spanning 8 professional domains, from software engineering and formal mathematics to legal analysis and 3D production. Each task specifies an initial workspace and an integrated deliverable composed of interdependent components, which is assessed by a hidden verifier. Agents determine autonomously whether and how to delegate, and all delegation is recorded, enabling joint evaluation of deliverable quality and the organization of the underlying work. Experiments with nine models show that no single configuration performs best across all domains and that systems exhibit distinct delegation strategies: at high effort, Claude models in Claude Code invoke workflows less frequently but with larger worker groups, whereas GPT models in Codex delegate more frequently in smaller units. When the executing model is held fixed on a challenging subset of tasks, workflows authored by Claude Opus 5.5 substantially improve weaker executors, indicating that workflow organization is itself a measurable determinant of task performance.

items.whatChanged: WorkflowArena benchmark shows no single model configuration dominates across all professional domains, revealing distinct delegation strategies like Claude Code's low-frequency but large-group worker usage.
items.whyItMatters: Test the assumption that a universal agent orchestration strategy exists; consider domain-specific workflow templates rather than one-size-fits-all delegation logic.
items.evidenceQuote: Experiments with nine models show that no single configuration performs best across all domains
items.limitations: Results apply to 145 tasks in 8 domains; does not prove superiority for specific use cases or long-term stability.

items.whatChanged: Eval-driven development (EDD) proposes building agents by measuring performance against consistent metrics and hill-climbing toward those evals in CI and production.
items.whyItMatters: Implement a CI pipeline that runs fixed evals to objectively judge agent changes, replacing manual testing for ambiguous improvements.
items.evidenceQuote: Eval-driven development (EDD) involves building an agent while measuring performance against a consistent set of metrics
items.limitations: Source describes the methodology but does not provide empirical results on its effectiveness compared to traditional development.

items.whatChanged: Meta launched Muse Ember, a model priced at $0.10/$0.50 per million input/output tokens, significantly cheaper than Claude Fable 5.2 at $8/$40.
items.whyItMatters: Evaluate whether Muse Ember can replace Fable 5.2 for high-volume, complex reasoning tasks where cost-per-token is the primary constraint.
items.evidenceQuote: For shorter prompts it's priced the same as GPT-6 Luna and Claude Haiku 5.5 - both are $0.10/million input tokens and $0.50/million output
items.limitations: Pricing applies only to shorter prompts; token usage variance for reasoning tasks makes direct cost comparison unreliable without benchmark data.
